summary: Milestone 1.2 correction pass VERIFIED on the external preview URL. Portrait flow (390x844): main-menu-screen -> play-button -> difficulty-screen (rookie/club/pro visible, back-button returns to menu) -> difficulty-club -> match-screen. Watercolour Skia court renders after ~8-10s. HUD score-display reads exactly '0 – 0 – 2'. KITCHEN-TOGGLE REMOVAL CONFIRMED: no element with testID 'kitchen-toggle' exists on the match screen. PAUSE OVERLAY CORRECT: tapping pause-button shows pause-overlay containing EXACTLY three buttons (resume-button / restart-button / quit-button labelled Resume / Restart / Quit to Menu). No share-button inside pause-overlay. result-overlay is NOT visible while paused. Resume closes the overlay. Pause layout verified fully on-screen and tappable at both 390x844 and 360x640 viewports (all three buttons have in-viewport bounding boxes). Serve: upward swipe (mouse down at 195,600 -> 12 small upward steps -> mouse up) correctly advanced debug phase from 'waiting_serve' to 'rally' (ball z 0.0 -> 0.4) and Rally counter 0 -> 1 with no crash. Landscape viewport (844x390) correctly displays rotate-overlay. No red screens, no runtime errors, no backend calls (client-only). Only non-blocking console deprecation warnings (same as iteration_1): react-native-skia path API, props.pointerEvents, shadow* style props.

react_native_issues.issue: SkPath.moveTo/lineTo/addPath/close/quadTo/addRRect are deprecated; migrate to Skia.PathBuilder.Make(). Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/game/render/CourtRenderer.tsx (and GameCanvas.tsx) path building.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/match.tsx lines 144, 163, 168, 175 (<View pointerEvents="box-none"/"none">).
'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx playBtn style (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset).

Optional (carried over): migrate Skia path building to Skia.PathBuilder.Make() in CourtRenderer.tsx / GameCanvas.tsx.
Optional (carried over): move pointerEvents from prop to style in match.tsx.

critical_code_review_comments: match.tsx pause overlay (lines 190-205) correctly renders only Resume/Restart/Quit — share-button is scoped exclusively to the result overlay (lines 229-240), matching the spec.
Pause overlay is wrapped in a padded modalWrap with pauseModal maxWidth 360 — layout verified to fit 360x640 small-phone viewport without clipping.
Result overlay is gated on `gameOver && !paused` effectively because pause overlay rendering block is `paused && !gameOver` — they are mutually exclusive, so result cannot bleed through pause.
No kitchen-toggle testID remains in match.tsx; stale `kitchenBtn*` styles still linger in the StyleSheet (lines 271-274) — dead-code cleanup only, not blocking.

All interactive elements correctly expose testID: play-button, back-button, difficulty-{rookie,club,pro}, match-screen, score-display, pause-button, pause-overlay, resume-button, restart-button, quit-button, rotate-overlay, result-overlay, rematch-button, menu-button, share-button, final-score.
